item.title: v1.1.0 In Preparation
item.description:
Changes

This update is planned to unlock the following:

  • support for Easy Backup
  • Auto Load on Launch and Load Manually
  • support for viewing and reviewing Question Sets saved in Uni:Note

item.title: v1.0.0 Release
item.description:
Changes

This update included the following:

  • first public release of Uni:Note Pocket
  • support for importing and validating Uni:Note backups
  • support for note lists, page viewing, and memorization layer toggles
